svg.text: Request 5 Phase A: J0337 Published-Bound Translation
Posterior mapping from published Delta bounds to (sigma1, sigma2), marginalized over s_NS priors.
prior optimistic sigma1 optimistic sigma2 conservative sigma1 conservative sigma2
Interpretation: the data-driven numbers are the conditional slices (|sigma1|_95 ~ 1e-5 at sigma2=0, |sigma2|_95 ~ 1e-4 at sigma1=0).
The joint 2D marginal quantiles sit on an open degeneracy ridge and track the flat prior box (see box_scale_check); they are box-conditional, not standalone constraints.
Delta inputs: Voisin et al. (2025), A&A 693, A143 (arXiv:2411.10066), planet vs red-noise timing-noise hypotheses.
